summary: The bedroom is presented in generally good, modern decorative order with clean off-white emulsioned walls and fitted grey carpeting throughout. Furnishings include a double bed with dark grey tufted headboard, matching bedside units, a chest of drawers, and dual bedside lamps. Notable localized defects include isolated wall scuffs and a small stain above the headboard, surface smudges on metallic switch plates, and a small tear on the lower edge of the mattress.

items.name: Walls
items.description: Plastered and emulsioned walls in off-white/pale grey matt finish to four elevations, with plain painted reveals to window
defects: curved rub/scuff marks mid level to wall above skirting (P045)
cluster of light scratch/rub marks low to mid level right hand side adjacent heater (P046)
small orange/brown spot mark chest to high level right hand side above headboard (P048)
faint shade/rub marking high level to wall above headboard (P049)
light shade marking mid level to wall left hand side of window reveal (P050)
light scuffing low level adjacent bedside chest (P044)

items.name: Ceiling & Vent Grille
items.description: Smooth white emulsioned ceiling with recessed downlight fittings and a linear black/white air conditioning grille above the door.

items.name: Skirting Boards
items.description: Painted timber moulded skirting in white gloss/satin finish to perimeter of room, approx 100mm high
defects: angle chip/indentation low level to top bead of skirting on window wall (P047)
light scuff marks low level to skirting behind heater (P046)
light rub marks low level to skirting adjacent door (P053)

items.name: Internal Door & Frame
items.description: White painted flush internal door with black lever handle on rose, three chrome butt hinges, painted white timber frame/architrave and black cylindrical floor-mounted doorstop
defects: light rub marks to leading edge and around handle to interior face (P036)
light scuff marks low level to bottom rail
black doorstop to low level right hand side of frame — sound but scuffed (P053, P058)

items.name: Window & Glazing
items.description: White UPVC/aluminium framed double-glazed opening window with top hopper and matching white internal sill.

items.name: Roller Blind
items.description: Off-white fabric roller blind mounted inside window recess with beaded metal pull chain and safety cleat.

items.name: Bed Frame & Headboard
items.description: Double bed base upholstered in dark grey/charcoal fabric with under-bed storage drawers, brass corner accents, and a matching high-back deep button-tufted fabric headboard.

items.name: Mattress
items.description: Manor Collection quilted double pocket sprung mattress, white damask ticking with tufted buttons and stitched border, on dark grey fabric divan base
defects: dark grey/black spot stain approx 10mm to stitched border low level left hand side (P040)
light shade/discolouration marks to quilted top surface (P038, P039)
light soiling to piped edge

items.name: Bedside Tables
items.description: Pair of white gloss/matt lacquered three-drawer bedside chests with geometric diamond-faceted drawer fronts, brushed brass bar handles and brushed brass hairpin legs; approx 600mm wide
defects: manufacturer's barcode labels remaining to interior base of drawers (P041, P042)
light dust to drawer interiors
light rub marks to brushed brass fixing plate within drawer (P041)

items.name: Chest of Drawers
items.description: White three-drawer chest featuring geometric faceted drawer fronts, satin brass handles, and gold-finish metal hairpin legs.

items.name: Bedside Table Lamps
items.description: Pair of modern table lamps with black metal rectangular open-loop bases and cream/beige rectangular fabric shades.

items.name: Electrical Switches, Sockets & Thermostat
items.description: Black nickel/polished bronze-effect screwless flat plate electrical accessories comprising single rocker light switch, three-gang switch plate, twin switched socket outlets, and black glass-fronted digital heating/thermostat control panel
defects: heavy finger smears and shade marking to polished plate of single switch (P043, P060)
finger marks and smearing to glazed face of thermostat/control panel (P043)
smears and tarnish-like marking to three-gang switch plate (P052)
dust and finger marks to socket plate right hand side of window wall (P037, P057)

items.name: Portable Oil-Filled Radiator
items.description: Freestanding black multi-fin electric oil-filled radiator heater on castors with digital push-button controls.
